FINAL OWNER DIRECTIVE
MAKE IVX IA CHAT A TRUE SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

Do not continue adding isolated features.

The highest priority is completing the IVX IA Brain.

The goal is that the owner can use IVX IA Chat as the primary engineering interface instead of relying on Rork.

==================================================
MISSION
==================================================

IVX IA Chat must become a real Senior Software Engineer.

The owner should be able to have long technical conversations exactly as with ChatGPT.

The AI must think, explain, reason, recommend, create engineering tasks, monitor execution, and verify production.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — NATURAL CONVERSATION
==================================================

Remove all remaining conversation gaps.

The AI must:

• understand normal English
• understand Spanish
• understand mixed language
• understand imperfect grammar
• maintain context for long conversations
• answer directly
• avoid unnecessary clarification loops

==================================================
PHASE 2 — SENIOR ENGINEERING REASONING
==================================================

The AI must discuss naturally:

• Architecture
• React Native
• Expo
• TypeScript
• Backend
• APIs
• Supabase
• PostgreSQL
• AWS
• Render
• Docker
• GitHub
• CI/CD
• Security
• Performance
• Production debugging
• Scaling
• Database design

Responses must include reasoning, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations.

==================================================
PHASE 3 — ENGINEERING ASSISTANT
==================================================

When asked to fix something:

1. Explain the problem.
2. Identify the probable root cause.
3. Describe the implementation plan.
4. Estimate the impact.
5. Create the autonomous task.
6. Execute after required approval.
7. Verify production.
8. Return evidence.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — CONTEXT MEMORY
==================================================

The AI must remember:

Current project

Current deployment

Previous discussion

Previous recommendations

Current autonomous jobs

Current production state

Owner preferences

The owner should never need to repeat the same context.

==================================================
PHASE 5 — AUTONOMOUS INTEGRATION
==================================================

The AI must know what Autonomous is doing.

Questions such as:

"What are the workers doing?"

"What did they finish?"

"Why is this blocked?"

"What changed today?"

must produce live answers from the task system.

==================================================
PHASE 6 — PRODUCTION AWARENESS
==================================================

The AI must always know:

Current GitHub SHA

Current Render deployment

Current production health

Open P0 issues

Running jobs

Blocked jobs

Pending approvals

Latest deployments

Latest regressions

==================================================
PHASE 7 — DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE
==================================================

Talking to IVX IA Chat should feel like talking to an experienced senior engineer.

The AI should:

Explain.

Recommend.

Compare options.

Review code.

Design architecture.

Diagnose failures.

Create tasks.

Track execution.

Verify results.

Not simply route messages.

==================================================
PHASE 8 — FINAL CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Do not certify IVX IA until the following are verified:

✓ Natural conversation

✓ Long context

✓ Engineering reasoning

✓ Code review

✓ Architecture review

✓ Production debugging

✓ Autonomous task creation

✓ Autonomous monitoring

✓ Deployment verification

✓ Production verification

✓ Evidence reporting

The final result should be:

The owner no longer needs Rork for normal engineering conversations.

The owner uses IVX IA Chat as the permanent Senior Software Engineer.

Only return VERIFIED after all capabilities are demonstrated with live production evidence.
